This is the reality that COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides, deploying in 48 hours a complete combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, configured for end-to-end testing and 30-day support. By reading this post, you'll learn the real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-pdf-guides-without-gumroad|The Real]] behind Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, and how you can [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-step-step|start]] deploying your own sovereign stack today.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting platform that allows users to automate tasks and workflows on Google Sheets, Docs, and other G Suite applications. In the context of digital commerce, Apps Script can be used to automate order fulfillment, product delivery, and customer communication, all without the need for Stripe or any other payment gateway. This is particularly important for creators living in countries where Stripe is restricted, as it provides a sovereign alternative for processing crypto payments and delivering digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds, thanks to the efficient architecture that underlies Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook triggers a Cloudflare Worker, which then updates the Supabase database with the new order information. This information is then used to generate a download link for the digital product, which is delivered to the customer via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The entire process is automated, and can be configured to work with any cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is built for digital creators who want to own and control their infrastructure, without relying on Stripe or any other platform. This includes creators living in countries where Stripe is restricted, as well as those looking to build a more sovereign and decentralized digital commerce ecosystem. With Edge Commerce Stack, creators can deploy a complete combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, configured for end-to-end testing and 30-day support.
Every order gets the same automated treatment — whether it arrives at noon or 3am, one order or ten simultaneously.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages provides the hosting infrastructure for the digital store, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic for automating order fulfillment and product delivery. Supabase is used for order storage, and NOWPayments provides the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Google Apps Script is used to integrate these components and automate the workflow, all without the need for Stripe or any other payment gateway.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Use Google Apps Script to integrate these components and automate the workflow, and configure the entire stack for end-to-end testing and 30-day support.
